Definition: neuter from G4660; something stripped (as a hide), i.e. booty:--spoil.
BiblicalUsage: When a stronger than the strong man comes and overcomes him, he takes away all his armour and divides his spoils. The spoil here is what the defeated enemy trusted in, carried off by the one who beat him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the picture is plain: the enemy's armour is no protection against the Stronger One, and what he trusted in ends up divided as spoil.
